title: Laranon: Reversible PII Anonymization for Laravel and LLMs
content:
Laranon finds personal data in Laravel apps and replaces it with tokens before it reaches an LLM, then puts the real values back in the model's reply.

The post Laranon: Reversible PII Anonymization for Laravel and LLMs appeared first on Laravel News.
